title: Efficacy and Tolerability of Apevitin BC Comparing to Vitamin Complex in Stimulating the Appetite
brief_summary: Lack of appetite is one of the most common reasons for visits to pediatric clinics.The symptoms usually manifest after weaning when they are introduced into the diet of infant foods containing salt.Is normally used to cyproheptadine in conjunction with vitamins C and B and also vitamins complex.
condition: Lack or Loss Appetite Nonorganic Origin
